stories.title: M-F.1 — quick-win detectors (3)
acceptanceCriteria: SLIP INVOKED (M-F.1 pre-committed: drop to 2 if earlier stages overran — S2/S3/S4 had blockers): shipped 2 robust quick-wins (inline-handler-cost fiber-based, ref-mutation-during-render conservative source). useFormStatus-outside-form deferred — needs form-ancestry (fiber-level), FP-prone from source.

Three quick-win detectors under src/inject/detectors/: inline-handler-cost (inline arrow/function prop created every render on a memo'd child), ref-mutation-during-render (ref.current mutated in render body), use-form-status-outside-form (useFormStatus called outside a <form> action context).

Each emits a new additive IssueType (INLINE_HANDLER_COST / REF_MUTATION_DURING_RENDER / USE_FORM_STATUS_OUTSIDE_FORM), is registered + added to KNOWN_DETECTORS_DEFAULTS with a declared confidence, and has a fixture + emit/zero test.
npx tsc --noEmit exits 0; full test:run green; CHANGELOG entries.

stories.title: M-F.2 — opt-in telemetry pipeline (deploy = humanGate)
acceptanceCriteria: src/services/telemetry.ts: record(event, payload) buffering + hourly batch flush (DI'd clock + sender), gated behind an opt-in flag (default OFF).
Per-detector counters payload schema {detector, fires, dismisses, fpClicks, ext_version, react_version}.
PAYLOAD AUDIT test: an assembled telemetry payload contains NO host URLs, NO component names, NO user data (only counters + versions) — asserted against a fixture with such data present.
Opt-out honored: record() while disabled buffers/sends nothing. npx tsc --noEmit exits 0 and the telemetry suite passes.

stories.title: M-F.3 — 2026 retrospective doc
acceptanceCriteria: docs/RETROSPECTIVE-2026.md summarizes what shipped (S0-S6 stages + detectors), what was gated to the maintainer (human gates), and the 2027 kickoff topics.
A test/lint asserts the doc exists and names all 4 hero detectors + the MCP server + the UI redesign. (Opening the GitHub Discussion = humanGate.)
